quotes: Huge portions and bottled sauces at the table
A lot of food for the price.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Most mention friendly, efficient staff, but one tourist found the order-taking staff rude and another found employees rushed.
quotes: the staff who took our order at checkout was perhaps the rudest we encountered in New York

themes.label: Service and staff attention
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive, fast staff, while others report being ignored, an unkind waitress, or poor attention.
quotes: Waiters are on point and very attentive to your needs.
Pity attention, we arrived ordered, the food arrived and no one else came to ask if everything was fine

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Most reviewers describe big portions and plenty of food, but one delivery customer found the portions very small.
quotes: You could feed an army off one or two dishes.
But what small portions.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices decent or affordable for the amount of food, though a few call it expensive for what you get.
quotes: the prices are very high.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and authentic Colombian, but some found it cold, bland, precooked or declining in quality.
quotes: The food was lousy, cold without flavor and the juices also super bad.
Soup had plenty of shrimp. Really good.

themes.label: Parking difficulty
themes.text: Reviewers say parking near the restaurant is hard to find.
quotes: Only one problem is very hard to find parking on roosevelt ave..

themes.label: Staff friendliness and attitude
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, courteous staff, while others describe rude, angry or dismissive employees, including managers.
quotes: The staff is friendly & courteous.
These people are rude as hell unless you are Mexican they treat you like you are invading in their business

themes.label: Order accuracy
themes.text: Reviewers report wrong, mixed-up or incomplete orders, and some blame language barriers or items being unavailable.
quotes: When order always mix up. If you say no sugar. They add suger. They don't serve as you order.
they have been wrong with my order as 5 times.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Many describe quick service even when busy, but some report long waits and slowness, especially after the remodel.
quotes: Friendly staff, quick even with busy.
we have to wait for long time to get the food.

themes.label: Fries and burgers
themes.text: Fries are repeatedly praised as hot, fresh and delicious, and some like the burgers, though one finds them greasy.
quotes: it's always crowded so the fries are always hot and fresh!!
When i want the most delicious fries available this is where i go

themes.label: Cleanliness and crowding
themes.text: Some find the place dirty, crowded or lacking seating, while others call it clean and nice after the upgrade.
quotes: They don't care for a clean place of business. It's always dirty
Very clean and the attention is nice

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers overwhelmingly praise the large, varied beer list across taps, bottles and cans, including sours and imports.
quotes: Fantastic beer selection over 370 beers to choose from!
Perhaps the best beer selection in Manhattan that I've seen.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most find the food good, especially burgers and wings, though some call it just okay and criticise the poutine, deviled eggs and pretzel.
quotes: The food is awesome - get the burger with tots, you won't regret it.
Food is admittedly just okay, but decent.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Bartenders are widely described as friendly and knowledgeable, but a few reviewers report slow or absent service.
quotes: Bartenders are super knowledgeable about beer.
Nobody behind the bar, great place if you want to just sit there without a drink for 20 minutes.

themes.label: Games and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the relaxed, comfortable vibe and the upstairs games such as darts and shuffleboard, plus trivia night.
quotes: Great craft beers, great vibe, great games, awesome layout
2nd floor is game fun!!!

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable and takeout beer cheap, while others say the place is pricey or slightly expensive per beer.
quotes: Fantastic beer selection and reasonable prices.
Great service. Expensive though.

themes.label: Pizza quality and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the Neapolitan-style pizza, citing its light, charred crust and fresh toppings, though a few found the crust thick, rubbery, burnt or soggy.
quotes: The crust is fluffy and light with delicious flavor. The oven is nice and hot giving the pizza a gentle char.
Rubbery flavorless crust, chef boyardee meatballs, tomatoes have no flavor.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, courteous and attentive staff, though some reported slow service, long waits and inattentive waiters.
quotes: The staff was amazingly friendly.
really slow service, which is especially bad since Neapolitan pizzas cook so quickly!

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Reviewers split on cost: several call it pricey or overpriced, while others say it is worth it or reasonable, and the lunch deal is praised.
quotes: Not cheap but very delicious and worth the price
Watered and expensive pizzas for what they are.

themes.label: Delivery and takeout problems
themes.text: Delivery and takeout drew complaints about very long delays, undercooked or soggy pizza, missing items and a piece of plastic in a salad.
quotes: It took an hour and half, despite being told it would be much sooner.
The only downside is that it arrives soggy when delivered

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: Reviewers describe a tiny, cozy, intimate restaurant that is popular and may need a reservation, with a nice terrace or street seating.
quotes: You will want to make a reservation as it is small and very popular!
Tiny and cozy restaurant with delicious original pizza

themes.label: Dim sum quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the dim sum and dumplings, some rating them as good as or better than Chinatown, though one says to head to Chinatown instead.
quotes: If you look past the somewhat sterile decor of this place you are in for some great dim sum.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, fast, attentive service, but a few report lukewarm or poor service, a refusal of service, and language difficulties.
quotes: They have lightning fast service and a super nice host.
Average Chinese food and average luke warm service.

themes.label: Gluten-free menu
themes.text: Reviewers value the extensive gluten-free menu and the restaurant's care with gluten allergies, including gluten-free dumplings.
quotes: Spectacular extensive Gluten Free menu. Finally found GF dumplings.
Huge menu with large selection of gluten free items.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable with good lunch specials and generous portions, while others call it pricey or poor value for the quality.
quotes: It is also one of the more pricey options -- but the extra $ are worth it.
It was over priced for the quality. It's not worth it.

themes.label: Decor and cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as clean, modern and nicely decorated, though one calls the decor somewhat sterile.
quotes: Much cleaner and friendlier than places in Chinatown and Flushing.
Enjoyed dim sum lunch with a friend in this beautifully decorated resraurant.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food good value and reasonably priced for Midtown, though a couple find it pricey or the portions small.
quotes: The food is fresh and delicious. Prices are very reasonable. Great spot for lunch.
Pricey, but what spot isn't in midtown?

themes.label: Healthy fresh food
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the food as fresh, healthy and flavorful, with falafel, lamb meatballs and toppings singled out.
quotes: Fresh wholesome food. Great flavors. Filling portions.
Grass fed steak and spicy lamb meatballs are awesome

themes.label: Lunch lines and crowding
themes.text: Lunch lines are long, but several reviewers say they move fast, and online ordering is suggested to avoid them.
quotes: the queue at lunch time is 50 deep at least - so use the app to pre order.
Quite crowded but goes fast

themes.label: Running out of items

one day they ran out of rice and salads, it's was disappointing

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Some reviewers praise friendly, helpful staff, while others describe staff as indifferent, unfriendly or sarcastic.

One in particular will look at you as though they are doing you a favor by serving you the sides you request

themes.label: Overcharging and pricing accuracy

quotes: have a tendency to over-charge if you're not paying attention
They will charge you different prices than their menu says. Be careful!

themes.label: Friendly staff and service

Terrible service. Over priced.

themes.label: Sandwich size and variety

quotes: The sandwiches are very good, big and good. Lots of variety.
good sized sandwiches and a great selection of beverages

themes.label: Order mistakes

quotes: They always mess up my orders and overcharge me.
he found a staple inside it! A staple!

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as clean, fresh and bright.
quotes: Bright and clean usually. One of the better bodegas in midtown.
Love this place it's clean and they are very respectful.

themes.label: Authentic Mexican dishes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the Mexican food, especially tacos, al pastor, tortas, enchiladas with mole and tostadas, often calling it authentic or the best in the area.

Best Al Pastor tacos in Astoria !

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as fresh, flavorful and made with care.
quotes: the food here is very tasteful because it's made fresh.
The food is wonderful and fresh here!!!

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers describe the staff, owner and family-run service as friendly, welcoming and fast.
quotes: Excellent family style service and dishes
The staff is super nice and you can order online for pickup or delivery as well, which is convenient!

themes.label: Pizza options
themes.text: A few reviewers single out pizza, including the cheese and jalapeño pizzas, as favorites for themselves or their children.
quotes: you must try the jalapeño Pizza... Only at Emilias
I like to get the enchiladas de mole and my son the pizza.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Two reviewers note the restaurant takes only cash, but they still rate it highly because of the food.
quotes: Just get the Mexican food (cash only)
Although its cash only... its awesome authentic mexican food!

themes.label: Salad quality and freshness
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the salads as fresh, tasty and customizable, with good variety of greens, toppings and dressings.
quotes: Very delicious and fresh salads. Great variety of greens, meats and veggies.
Just tasty and fresh salads. No more no less.

themes.label: Lunch line speed
themes.text: Lines at lunchtime are long and crowded, and most say they move quickly, though a few describe long waits or a mess.
quotes: No matter how long lunchline it moves quick.
Be prepared to be there at least 20 minutes - and that's if the line is short.

themes.label: Delivery and online orders
themes.text: Delivery and ahead orders drew complaints about late arrivals, missing dressings or items, and salads not filled fully.

whenever you order ahead for pickup or grubhub, I haven't had a good experience.

themes.label: Price versus portion
themes.text: Several reviewers find the salads pricey for what is included, though some say the quality makes up for the cost.
quotes: Expensive not enough included toppings for the price
Although it's more expensive than a salad from any old deli, their salads and dressing choices make up for it.

themes.label: Staff and service

some of the servers are sometimes lazy to properly chop your salad.

themes.label: Pizza quality and value

Pizza is excellent super fresh ingredients of very good quality.

themes.label: Service and staff attitude
themes.text: Some found staff friendly and service great, while others described staff as unwilling, rude, or unable to handle orders correctly.

The staff looks like they don't want to be here, and the music is obnoxiously loud

themes.label: Delivery speed and accuracy
themes.text: Several reviewers praised fast, warm deliveries, but others reported a cancelled order after a long wait and a delivery that missed instructions.

Seamless 40 minutes later that the restaurant has cancelled my order because the restaurant is closed.

themes.label: Food too salty or bland

it was so bland and the chicken was rubbery

themes.label: Pasta and Hispanic dishes

Delicious Hispanic food and pasta too

themes.label: Authentic homemade pasta and pizza

Fresh ingredients, homemade pasta, flavorful and great wine menu.

themes.label: Cash only policy

We were not told cash only when we walked in and there were no signs in the front that says so.

themes.label: Owner and service

Waiters are rude and act put upon to deliver cheese or crushed red pepper and don't check back.

the place is very small. If you come here during the peak time, it's likely that you have to wait for a while.

themes.label: Reasonable prices

Food is ok for how expensive it is but nothing special.

Xiao Long baos were a disappointment- skin was too thick.

themes.label: Friendly, quick service

themes.label: Prices and value

quotes: Good pricing for good food.
they are a bit pricier than the average in this neighborhood

themes.label: Small cozy atmosphere

themes.label: Entrees and noodle dishes

Everything we ordered tasted super bland.

themes.label: Arepas quality and variety

So many different arepas to try.

themes.label: Service quality

The place is cozy and pleasant, the service and attention is poor.

themes.label: Sangria and drinks

Try the chicha (drink made with rice, condensed milk, and cinnamon).

themes.label: Prices and specials

You get full on a dinner for 2 for $20.

needs a face lift inside and prices are good

themes.label: Speed and quality of service

Difficult to get table available

themes.label: Bathroom and cleanliness

themes.label: In-store DJ

themes.label: Friendly attentive service

Excellent service! Plums Delight tastes amazing.

themes.label: Fair prices

we couldn't believe the price!

themes.label: Happy hour deals

themes.label: Friendly attentive service

we were welcomed to come in no problem.

themes.label: Fresh seafood and oysters

themes.text: Many praise friendly, fast bartenders and attentive staff, but others describe being ignored, slow drink service, a rude hostess and inattentive waitstaff.
quotes: Bartenders are fast and friendly.
The bartenders never acknowledged our presence. Needless to say, we walked out, still thirsty.

themes.label: Near Grand Central trains
themes.text: Reviewers value the location close to Grand Central, the posted train departure times, and it being a handy place to wait for a train.
quotes: it's a great place to wait for the next train out of Grand Central. The bar has a screen with upcoming train departures.
Good after work place especially for those that commute via trains. Was able to run to the train within 3 minutes.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Several say it gets packed and loud, especially after work, while others found it empty or easy to get a table.
quotes: 4 stars as it's way too packed and too loud - impossible to hear anything
It was not difficult to find a table after work for 10 people.

themes.label: Beer selection and prices
themes.text: Many like the beer selection, but some were unimpressed by it, and several call the prices steep while others find it good value.
quotes: I was let down a little by the beer list, it was nothing exciting
It is a bit pricey so be ready when the bill arrives.

themes.label: Pizza and crust quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin New York-style slices and crispy crust, but a few found the pizza bland, soft, greasy or freezer-tasting.
quotes: Perfect New York crust. Highly recommended.
Truly the worst pizza I've had in a long time.

themes.label: Small space, limited seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe a tiny place with only a few tables, best suited to takeout or delivery, and some note there is no bathroom.
quotes: This is your small (4 tables) mostly take out pizza place.
No restroom is the only downside but the pizza makes up for it.

themes.label: Low prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers say the slices are cheap, reasonably priced and good value for New York.
quotes: If you want a quick and cheap slice in NYC, this is a great choice.
Great tasting pizza at a great price!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Several reviewers found the staff friendly and service fast, while others described rude service and unreliable delivery.
quotes: Have always enjoyed friendly service here.
Super greasy pies, rude staff, and totally undependable delivery

themes.label: Near theaters and landmarks
themes.text: Reviewers like it for a quick slice before or after a movie or the opera nearby.
quotes: Good for quick bite of pizza after movies.
ideal for snacks before entering the opera.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive, accommodating staff, though a few describe awkward or mediocre service, rude staff and a billing problem.
quotes: Our waiter was really attentive and nice. Highly recommended!
However staff was rude, and when I checked my statement after having paid by credit card

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call prices decent, fair or good value, while several others find the restaurant pricey or overpriced.
quotes: Delicious and reasonably priced ramen and they have many different options, even rice bowls if you're not feeling ramen.
Ramen was really meh and pork buns were nothing special and it is very overpriced.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers say the small restaurant is busy, noisy and often has waits, though the electronic waitlist is praised and some find the wait worthwhile.
quotes: The wait can get pretty long (30 mins-1hr) on Friday and Saturday nights because the restaurant is pretty small, but it's worth it.
Love the iPad at the front where you enter your name and mobile # to get on the waitlist

themes.label: Generous ramen portions
themes.text: Reviewers describe large, filling portions of ramen and other dishes.
quotes: Ramen bowls are huge. It can feed 2.
The portions are really big and the dishes are really good.

themes.label: Volcano and spicy ramen
themes.text: Spicy ramens such as the volcano and spicy tonkatsu are singled out as flavorful favorites.
quotes: The volcano ramen is so good! I like the soup which is full of flavor and spicy.
The pork broth is just so masterfully done.

themes.label: Friendly, helpful staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise nice staff, managers and service, but a few describe rude managers or workers when orders went wrong.
quotes: Really great staff here! They are always very nice and I witnessed their high degree of patience
I called the place and was greeted by an angry worker who yelled at me

themes.label: Delivery speed
themes.text: Many describe fast, hot delivery, while others report long delays, late arrivals and cold food.
quotes: Fastest delivery. And the pizzas are always so fresh hot and delicious.
The order arrived 50 minutes late, giving my students five minutes to eat.

themes.label: Order mistakes
themes.text: Several reviewers received wrong, incomplete or badly made orders, though some say the store fixed the problem.
quotes: Just recently two orders were messed up and I was upset plus too much spice added
Anything wrong with your order and they will fi x it

themes.label: Delivery fees and prices
themes.text: Some find the pizza cheap and good value, while many object to $4-$6 delivery fees and high prices.
quotes: A $6 delivery fee is absolutely outrageous.
getting your cheat day ratcheted up with a $7.99 large 3 topping carry-out can't be beat.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Many call the pizza delicious and fresh, but others find it ordinary, not NYC style, burnt or poorly cut.
quotes: My pizza and chicken was burnt. I deff couldnt enjoy it.
my friend and wife ordered thin crust pizzas from here and I tried it and it was a game changer.

themes.label: Queso
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the queso as a highlight, though one reviewer found it unremarkable.
quotes: The queso is incredible, and the fajitas are the best I've had in New York.
The Bob Armstrong dip with the habenero quest is the BEST queso in town!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise friendly, knowledgeable staff, while others report terrible, absent or mediocre service.
quotes: Service has been terrible multiple times which overshadows the fact that the food is good.

themes.label: Drinks and margaritas
themes.text: Margaritas, cocktails and other drinks are widely liked, including avocado, jalapeño and frozen margaritas and bottomless brunch drinks.
quotes: Really liked the avocado margarita, had a really intriguing flavor and texture.
They also have a great selection of margaritas.

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Several reviewers describe food taking an hour or more, including a very late takeout pickup with no communication.
quotes: We waited more than an hour for our food.
No communication, no delay estimate. Disgraceful.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers say menu items are expensive for Mexican or Tex-Mex, and some felt the food was not worth the price.
quotes: The only issue is the price of all the menu items.
Very Overpriced, really bad service, staff act like they are on vacation.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, creative and authentic, though a few call it only okay, generic, too spicy or dry.
quotes: By far the best Indian food I've had in America, great service, friendly staff, good mix of traditional Indian dishes and more innovative plates.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff and owners are widely described as friendly, attentive and welcoming, with a few reports of slow or poor service.
quotes: Staff was super attentive and kind.
Really TERRIBLE service. Waiting over 1 hour for main course that never arrived on a not so busy Sunday evening.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the modern, cozy, stylish space and back garden, though one found it poorly insulated and cold.
quotes: Relaxing ambiance. Modern and authentic. Great service. Good food.
It's a nice space, but poorly insulated. It was freezing where we were seated.

themes.label: Drinks and cocktails
themes.text: Many enjoy the creative cocktails and beers, but some found drinks weak, unbalanced or overpriced.
quotes: Great food. Awesome service. And phenomenal drinks.
The alcoholic drinks were not tasty, not well balanced and one just tasted like rubbing alcohol.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers feel prices are high and portions small, especially for delivery orders.
quotes: Quantity is a bit Small, but hey rent in Astoria is not cheap!
they charge a premium price..I think most entrees are $15+,which is v high compared to others

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, polite and helpful, though a couple of reviews report a rude manager and poor service.
quotes: Great friendly staff!! No bums hanging out
Service people are friendly, helpful and just plain nice.

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly say the restaurant is clean, some noting it is cleaner than other Popeyes locations, including the bathroom.
quotes: This popeyes was very clean compared to other popeyes that I have been in.
The place is very clean and the order was fast

themes.label: Fast service and lines
themes.text: Customers praise quick service and fast-moving lines even when busy, though some note lines or crowds at times.
quotes: Chicken was great! The line moved fast.
Fastest service I've ever experienced in a fast food restaurant despite the fact that they were busy each time I went.

themes.label: Chicken sandwich availability and quality
themes.text: The chicken sandwich is praised by some, but others report it sold out, sitting too long on the warmer, stale or greasy.
quotes: Spicy chicken sandwich puts Chic fil a and Wendy's to shame.
Horrible chicken sandwich. Sat TOO LONG on the warmer

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Most reviewers call the chicken and other food tasty, hot and fresh, but some found it not fresh, greasy, salty or lousy.
quotes: Very good food. Best fast food chicken in history
Food is not fresh as it could be. If it weren't for that I would eat there more

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Many call the burger among the best in the city, while others find it bland, dry, overcooked or merely average.
quotes: This is the best burger in Manhattan. No nonsense, no hipster spin.
For a place known for its burgers, the burger was super disappointing. It was bland and a bit dry.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise polite, attentive, fast and friendly staff and servers, though one review describes a rude server and another slow service.
quotes: The service is fantastic. Our server couldn't have been more attentive and was a pleasure.
Excellent food and great service

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair or reasonable, while others call the burger pricey, especially with fries and drinks charged separately.
quotes: Really tasty food, fast service, and fair prices.
$13 for a cheese burger that doesn't come with fries.

themes.label: Small burger size
themes.text: Several reviewers say the burgers are small, with some advising ordering two or splitting another.
quotes: Their burger is kinda small. Order two.
It's small so you have to split another one with the person you go with.

themes.label: Fries
themes.text: Many praise the cottage fries as great or outstanding, but a few find them mediocre, forgettable or not their favorite.
quotes: The burgers are really good and the cottage fries are outstanding.
The fries are round chips which is different but are otherwise forgettable.

themes.label: Pancakes and waffles
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the pancakes and waffles, including chocolate, apple and bacon waffle versions, with several calling them among the best they have had.
quotes: I came here with no expectations and was blown away by the best pancakes that i ever had.
the chocolate ones were amazing. Definitely on par with the best and known spots in the city.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, lousy or inattentive service and rude phone or manager behavior.
quotes: Service was great and friendly.
The food is really good and the place is cool but don't expect waiters that will take care of you.

themes.label: Lines and waiting
themes.text: Reviewers note long lines and crowding at brunch and peak times, though some say the line moves fast or is worth the wait.
quotes: Making it worse is the long line on the weekend one must endure for a mediocre meal.
The line was out the door for brunch but moved fast.

themes.label: Biscuits and strawberry butter
themes.text: Homemade biscuits with strawberry butter are singled out as a highlight of brunch.
quotes: The biscuits and strawberry butter make this place the best brunch on the Upper West Side.

themes.label: Stroller and kid policy
themes.text: Two reviewers say they were turned away because of a stroller and found the staff unwelcoming to families with children.
quotes: Refused to serve us because of stroller.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive, efficient staff, though a few found service average, rushed or poor.
quotes: Incredible service. Fun atmosphere and delicious food!
Amazing staff. Meticulous service. Friendly vibes. Good food. Good drinks.

themes.label: Crowded, tight seating
themes.text: Many describe tightly packed tables, crowding and noise, though some say the room is not too loud.
quotes: Too crowded, if you allowed they will accommodate another table on your table.
Space between table terrible and waiting staff did not care to help. Keep squeezing in more people....

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Several find it pricey with small portions for the quality, while a couple call the price reasonable or expected.
quotes: A bit pricey, but, when you go to a place like this, you should be expecting that.
The portions are tiny, prices are high, tables are tiny and cramped

themes.label: Burgers and bistro classics
themes.text: Reviewers single out the croque monsieur, French onion soup, burgers, tuna burger and fries as standout dishes.
quotes: order the croque-monsieur it is delicious and easily the best I have eaten in New York City.
The French Onion Soup is the best on the Upper west side

themes.label: Brunch dishes
themes.text: Brunch is well liked, with omelettes and French toast praised.
quotes: Omelettes, french toast the best, great coffee
It was perfectly cooked to my request - slightly runny.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and attitude
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive baristas, while others describe rude, unhappy or distracted staff who seem to hate their jobs.
quotes: I encountered one of the nicest baristas at this Starbucks. He was so friendly and pleasant, and our orders were quickly prepared to perfection.
awful service,everyone working here looks like they hate their job..no smiles no thank you

themes.label: Restroom and cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers often complain of dirty tables and a smelly, neglected restroom, though a few call the place clean.
quotes: Disgusting bathroom! Why does Starbucks not make it a priority to have the bathroom cleaned every hour?
very clean facility...i came here to get a mocha frappacino one time and they gave me extra whip cream

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Some find drinks come out quickly even in long lines, but others report long waits, slow lines and unprepared staff.
quotes: Even when there is a long line the wait is minimal, the staff here is friendly, efficient and do a great job of getting the drinks out fast.
I waited 8 minutes for my small cold brew when there was no one in line before me

themes.label: Order accuracy
themes.text: Several reviewers say their drink was made wrong, such as the wrong latte, no ice, or a non-gluten-free item, though one mistake was fixed generously.
quotes: I ordered an iced latte and they gave it to me without ice.
I ordered a Chai latte with soy and received a regular latte with soy even though I repeated Chai

themes.label: Seating and non-customers
themes.text: Reviewers find the space comfortable, bright and good for working, but complain about hard-to-find seats and non-buying people occupying tables and the restroom.
quotes: Relatively clean and good natural lighting. Quiet and decent customers. Good for reading or studying
To many people taking up seats and tables without even buying stuff from Starbucks

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many call it pricey or overpriced, with some saying the quality justifies the cost and others feeling small portions and mediocre food do not.
quotes: Although this place is a little pricey, there food is so flavorful that I don't even mind paying the extra money.
Rather small portion sizes for the price.

themes.label: Dumplings and creative dishes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the dumplings, including the Pac-Man ones, and the inventive, well-presented dishes.
quotes: The pac man dumplings are phenomenal
The food is amazingly good and inventive.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, accommodating staff, while others report annoyed servers, rushing, long waits, and a dismissive reply to a request for help.
quotes: Incredibly accommodating waiters! They really strived to make sure that I was as comfortable as possible.
Our server was clearly annoyed when we didn't want drinks other than water.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers expect long waits, difficulty getting a table, no reservations for smaller parties, and tightly packed or communal seating.
quotes: They do pack people in quite tight, so don't expect any private conversations or elbow room.
Red Farm is popular so expect a wait... But it is worth it.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cute decor, friendly atmosphere, and the bar area.
quotes: This is a fun restaurant to visit with good food, great bar in back (unexpected!) and cute decor.

themes.label: Sushi quality and freshness
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the sushi and sashimi as fresh and very good, with specialty rolls singled out, though one review found the sushi rice stale.
quotes: Try the Classic Roll plate. The sushi is really fresh.
I love the sushi here. Top notch fish and light on the rice.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Service and staff are frequently described as friendly, fast and accommodating, though one reviewer felt plates were taken away too early.
quotes: I loved how they were very accommodating to my food allergies.
Service is good, actually felt a little "hovering". Asking to take plates away before being done.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices reasonable and portions generous, with a few calling it somewhat pricey or the sushi portions small.
quotes: decently priced, and very generous portions.
sushi and sashimi were small portions

themes.label: Atmosphere and back dining room
themes.text: Reviewers describe a cozy, pleasant space, especially the back dining room and terrace, though one dislikes noisy children there.
quotes: The back of the restaurant is a nice environment
It's nice to sit outside on the terrace behind the restaurant.

themes.label: Cooked dishes and pad Thai
themes.text: Pad Thai, black cod and fried rice earn praise, but other cooked dishes were called frozen-tasting, bland or dry.
quotes: Huge pad Thai! Very recommended! Decently priced!
Saté tasted a bit like frozen chicken, gado gado had little taste.

themes.label: Pastrami and deli sandwiches
themes.text: Reviewers praise the pastrami, corned beef, brisket and other sandwiches as flavorful and authentic, with some rating them better than Katz's.
quotes: The Pastrami Sandwich is so flavorful add to that the spicy mustard and slaw
I actually think it was better than Katz's Deli and you don't have the crowds you can eat in peace.

themes.label: Pickles and coleslaw
themes.text: Pickles and coleslaw, often served free alongside meals, are repeatedly singled out as excellent, with half-sours especially loved.
quotes: lots of great free cole slaw and pickles
The pickles were sooo nostalgic of my childhood, nothing like some good Kosher Pickles.

themes.label: Matzo ball soup
themes.text: The matzo ball soup is described as tasty and even the best some reviewers have had, with some saying it cures colds.
quotes: their matzo ball soup is the best I've ever had. Cures my illness every time.
It has AMAZING matzoh ball soup!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly and service quick, but a few reported rude treatment, a gruff manager, and an added tip.
quotes: Super nice staff and tasty pastrami.
Gruff and arrogant service by manager, food is paltry and boring.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Many praise large portions and fair prices, while a few call the sandwiches expensive for their size.
quotes: Giant portions. Last real kosher deli.
The prices are too high for the small sandwich prices.

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the dining room and tables as clean and spacious, though one reports a damaged, dirty bathroom and tables.
quotes: Really clean and good service. The tables are clean.
The bathroom damaged and very dirty The tables

themes.label: Friendly staff
themes.text: Many reviewers found employees friendly, polite and attentive, including late at night and in Spanish, though a few reported rude staff.
quotes: Friendly employees even after 10PM!
Used to have good customer service but not no more. Rude workers.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Some reviewers praise quick, prompt service, while others complain of slow service, long waits and too few workers.
quotes: Orders take to long, need more workers at lunch time

themes.label: Prices and deals
themes.text: Reviewers like the cheap, reasonable prices and the coupons, app discounts and meal deals.
quotes: Good burgers... good prices.. get the coupons for better deals
The taste of hamburgers and the prices that are cheap.

themes.label: Order accuracy and food quality
themes.text: Many enjoyed the tasty food, but others received cold, bland or incomplete orders with missing toppings or wrong items.
quotes: Amazing place really nice fries and the burgers are great
Then when I get home I find out there were no lettuce in my sandwich and some of my fries were under cooked.

themes.label: Friendly attentive staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, attentive and helpful, often alongside good service overall.
quotes: the wait staff friendly and efficient, and the prices are great
The servers are super friendly.

themes.label: Order and service problems
themes.text: Some reviewers report wrong or missing orders, disorganised service, long waits despite empty tables, and unhelpful handling of delivery and pickup.
quotes: They brought my plate to the wrong table, took it back to the kitchen and by the time I finally got it, the food was like warm.
We ordered delivery and it never showed up, and no one at restaurant was willing to help on the phone.

themes.label: Pho and noodle soups
themes.text: Most praise the broth and soups, including curry and bun bo hue, but a few found them bland, flavourless or inauthentic.
quotes: I had Pho with brisket--excellent, rich broth and all the trimmings.
the beef and meatballs soup - ZERO flavor.

themes.label: Large portions, fair prices
themes.text: Reviewers say portions are big or generous and prices reasonable, though one notes an Upper West Side premium.
quotes: Very reasonable price. Bring your appetite as the food portions are substantial.
excellent food with generous portions at a good price.

themes.label: Spring rolls and banh mi
themes.text: Some enjoyed crispy spring rolls and fresh banh mi, while others found the rolls chewy or stale and the banh mi needing improvement.
quotes: Excellent and fresh bánh mi and crispy spring rolls.
Cha gio were kinda stale tasting.

themes.label: Fresh healthy food
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the food as fresh, healthy and tasty, with quality ingredients and many healthy options.
quotes: Could not believe how fresh the food was, this will be my new go to spot
I'd recommend this spot to anyone looking for healthy food with high-quality ingredients.

themes.label: Friendly helpful staff
themes.text: Reviewers describe the staff and service as friendly, helpful and professional, and say they help customers who are unsure how to order.
quotes: The staff is also very helpful.
It is not immediately clear how to order, but they help you.

themes.label: Customizable build-your-own meals
themes.text: Reviewers like choosing their own pasta, burger toppings, salad ingredients and other items made to order at multiple stations.
quotes: When I realized there was a choose-your-own pasta option, I had to try.
The setup gives the customer freedom to create different mixtures of foods and flavors.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers call prices reasonable or a good deal, while one finds the steak platter a bit expensive and another says it is not cheap.
quotes: Great food! Healthy food! Reasonably priced!
Platter with steak a bit expensive but the meat is amazing.

themes.label: Mixed views on specific dishes
themes.text: Salads, turkey and steak get praise, but the burger was called greasy and burnt, and some sides were described as flavorless.
quotes: The lamb soup was very good but the burger was greasy and burnt.
Veggie sides are flavorless.

themes.label: Burrito quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise the burritos as tasty, huge and better than Chipotle, with the spinach, steak and chicken ranchero versions singled out.
quotes: Undoubtably one of the best burritos in Manhattan. Amazing and huge. The spinach burrito is my favorite.
that steak burrito is much better than chipotle

themes.label: Small crowded space
themes.text: The place is tiny, crowded and has little seating, which some find claustrophobic, though many treat it as a hole-in-the-wall takeout gem.
quotes: being caught inside the tiny store front is very claustrophobic. Order for delivery or pickup in advance.
Only about 4 seats in the place but most orders are take out so you can usually get somewhere to sit.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many find prices fair and good value, but several say prices have risen or feel steep.
quotes: Great tacos at a fair price.
Prices are a bit steep even for manhattan

themes.label: Free chips and salsa
themes.text: Free chips and salsa come with orders and help while waiting for food.
quotes: Free chips and salsa while you wait!
Helps curb hunger while waiting for burrito.

themes.label: Vegetarian and vegan options
themes.text: Vegetarians and vegans are happy with the wide choice of veggie burritos and soy alternatives.
quotes: I was impressed with all of the vegetarian and vegan options!
Great selection of vegan and vegetarian burritos.

themes.label: Empanada taste and freshness
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the empanadas delicious, fresh and hot, with well-seasoned fillings, though a few found some fillings dry, greasy or light.
quotes: I cannot believe how amazingly tasty and fresh these empanadas taste!
It always comes out hot and stuffed with delicious well seasoned pork.

themes.label: Variety of flavors
themes.text: Customers like the large choice of empanadas, including vegetarian, sweet and dessert options, and corn or wheat shells.
quotes: There is so much choice you can't help but find a favorite!
They have about 6 different vegetarian empanadas. The broccoli and cheese is great.

themes.label: Staff attitude and service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, quick, polite staff, while others describe rude or unfriendly workers, unprofessional behavior, and a refusal of service to a customer with a service animal.
quotes: Service was amazing! The gentleman was cordial amd polite! Empanadas were hot amd tasty!
Bad, bad attention, the food is good but it is overshadowed by the bad attention provided.

themes.label: Waiting time
themes.text: Several reviewers report slow food or long waits, especially at peak times, though a few others found service fast.
quotes: only problem is at peak times it's packed and takes forever to order anything. Worst wait time was almost 30 minutes.
their food is frustratingly slow to come out. Delicious any time you go.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices cheap or reasonable, but some say it is pricey, that extras add up, or that sauce costs extra.
quotes: Really good empanadas and great price but a long wait
you have to pay extra if you want sauce. It doesn't make sense

themes.label: Singing waiters entertainment
themes.text: Reviewers overwhelmingly praise the singing staff and lively show, often saying the performances are the main reason to visit and make the meal fun.
quotes: Singing waiters and great food -Fun, fun, fun!
you eat well but above all you enjoy listening to the waiters sing..really good..deserves to queue to enter.

themes.label: Long waiting lines
themes.text: Many describe queues of an hour or more, though most feel the wait is worth it; some suspect people are kept outside despite free tables.
quotes: it seems there's an intention to keep people in a long line outside, even when there is plenty of seatings available.
Very entertaining. Worth the wait.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Opinions on the food split: many call it good or large portions, while others find it average, bland, mediocre or flavorless.
quotes: Sub par food, great entertainment makes up for it.
Very good food and great waiter/singers

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find the meal expensive for the food quality, though some say the show makes the price worthwhile.
quotes: Prices are higher compared to the surrounding restaurants. But it's so much fun that it's worth it.
Not anything great but UBER expensive.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise friendly, helpful staff and fast service, while others report rude hosts, terrible service or being ignored by servers.
quotes: Rudest hostess i have ever encountered.
Even with long lines, the service does not delay, super fast food.

themes.label: Pizza taste and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin, crisp-chewy crust and flavorful cheese slice as authentic New York pizza, though a few call it ordinary, burnt or soggy.
quotes: Awesome pizza. The crust is crunchy and chewy at the same time.
Excellent new york style pizza. Thin, crispy with the right amount of flavour.

themes.label: Fast service
themes.text: Reviewers say staff work quickly and the line moves fast, making it good for a quick bite.
quotes: Don't be afraid of lines as the workers are very efficient and the line moves in a matter of minutes.
They are working supeeer fast so if you are in a hurry this place is definitely recommended for quick stops.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find slices good value at about $3-4, while others call it pricey or overpriced for what they get.
quotes: $4.00 for a large slice. $2.00 for a soda. Good deal in the middle of times Square
This midtown location is especially bad and overpriced.

themes.label: Crowds and seating
themes.text: The shop is crowded with long lines and very little seating, so most people eat standing or outside.
quotes: The pizza is very good but it is impossible to find a place to sit.
Only 2 tables and a small counter that you can stand and eat

themes.label: Overrated hype
themes.text: Some reviewers felt the pizza was good but not exceptional and did not live up to its reputation.
quotes: the pizzas are good without being exceptional
Pizza is just OK: not bad, but not worth falling in line for

themes.label: Cheesecake
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the cheesecake excellent, often the main reason to visit, with red velvet, original and strawberry varieties singled out.

quotes: Great place to take in the beautiful views of the Throggs Neck Bridge and water.
Some best freshest seafood and incredible view

themes.label: Shrimp and fried seafood
themes.text: Many love the shrimp and fried seafood, while others found it flavorless, dry, or with breading falling off.
quotes: Love their shrimp! Been coming here for years, even before renovation.
The breading was falling off the shrimp and the fries were soggy.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Several reviewers point out the restaurant takes only cash, with an ATM on site, and some wish this would change.
quotes: Oh and this is still a CASH ONLY place (wish they would change that).
Minus one star because it's cash only, although there is an ATM on site.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find good prices and portions, especially at the raw bar, while others call it overpriced or say portions are too small.
quotes: Not enough food for your money.
Good food, great portion for the money.

themes.label: Sicilian square pizza
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the square Sicilian pizza, with its sauce on top and fluffy dough, as the best in Brooklyn, though a few found it undercooked or merely fine.
quotes: Few pizze go down quite as easily as their signature Sicilian (sauce on top, fluffy dough... It's a cloud made of pizza).
The square pie was tasty, but undercooked, very doughy...making it feel like it just sits at the bottom of your stomach.

themes.label: Spumoni dessert
themes.text: Reviewers regularly call the spumoni excellent and a must-try dessert, often the best they have had.
quotes: it was my first time trying spumoni. I'm officially hooked. Definitely worth the wait.
The spumoni next door is excellent as well.

themes.label: Crowds and parking
themes.text: Reviewers say the place gets packed and parking can be hard, though some note multiple windows, plenty of seating and a free lot.
quotes: Parking can be a hassle on weekends. I normally park a block away on Avenue V when the lot is full.
Recommended place but be aware that it's almost always packed

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most describe service as fast, nice or improving, while one reviewer said the waiter forgot the order and another called it just okay.
quotes: I've been going there for years and the service just gets better!
Waiter just forgetting what you ordered but after you recall him he remember.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find it fairly priced with big portions and good value, while others say prices have risen and it is expensive.
quotes: Prices are really getting out of hand, $9.75 for a meatball (3 meatballs) parm hero.
Great value for pie and quickest slice in the boro

themes.label: Friendly, helpful staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good customer service, though a few describe rude, annoyed or dishonest employees.
quotes: Staff was very sweet and thankful for the frontline.
Staff needs to be more friendly, they seemed upset and annoyed

themes.label: Fresh, tasty donuts
themes.text: Many reviewers say the donuts are fresh, delicious and melt in the mouth, with the glazed ones singled out.
quotes: Fresh baked Glazed Doughnuts are like heaven in your mouth!
Donuts were very fresh and tasty.

themes.label: Slow lines and waits
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, with online orders no faster than walk-ins, though some find the line short or worth it.
quotes: The regular line moves faster than ordering online!
it was only 7 of us in line and i had to wait for 45 minutes

themes.label: Cleanliness of the store
themes.text: Reviewers describe the store as clean and neat, and some note good social distancing.
quotes: It is very clean, the employees are friendly and the social distancing is well practiced.
The store was clean and shiny.

themes.label: Online and delivery order problems
themes.text: Several customers say online or delivery orders arrived missing, late or never, and that orders cannot be cancelled online.
quotes: Order for delivery my order never arrived I called to they told me my order left the store at 6:12
YOU CAN NOT CANCEL YOUR ORDER ONLINE. THERE IS NO OPTION FOR THAT.

themes.label: Long waits and lines
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long, slow lines, especially on weekends, but most say the food is worth the wait; a few call the service slow or disorganized.
quotes: Spent one hour plus on the line to get food today, Sunday, September 2nd.
Long lines but the food was worth the wait.

themes.label: Doubles quality
themes.text: Doubles are repeatedly called the best, with praise for the sauces and chutney, though one reviewer says they are no longer as good as before.
quotes: The best doubles I've tasted in a long time their cucumber chutney is wow
The only disappointment is that the doubles is no longer good like it was a few years ago.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service
themes.text: Some reviewers found staff rude or unhelpful, while others praised friendly, helpful and efficient service.
quotes: They behave as though they are doing you a favor and not that you are paying your money.
The staff is friendly and helpful and the shop itself is very clean.

themes.label: Authentic Trinidadian food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the food as authentic, fresh and reminiscent of home, with several traveling from Philly or Long Island for it.
quotes: Great authentic Trinidadian Curry...all the comforts of home
Love this place best Trini Food in New York worth the drive from Long Island .

themes.label: Cleanliness and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe the shop as clean and nicely kept, though weekend evening seating and parking are limited.
quotes: Clean establishment well lit with delicious food prepared fresh while you wait.
there aren't many available seats in the evening on weekends, we usually just take it home.

themes.label: Long but fast-moving lines
themes.text: Most reviewers say the long queues move quickly and are worth the wait, while a few find the lines a drawback.
quotes: The line is long but moves fast. They have a system down there to get you going.
There was a big queue when I went but it moved quickly

themes.label: Cheap, generous portions
themes.text: Reviewers praise the low price for large servings, though some note prices have climbed from about $5 to $9.
quotes: It's so good and big size and cheap. $7 can feed two
Since then pri e went from $5 to 8.taste is same.

themes.label: Very spicy red sauce
themes.text: Many warn that the red hot sauce is extremely hot, even for people used to spice, while white sauce is praised.
quotes: The spicy sauce is really spicy.
White sauce was 10/10 delicious. The red sauce was liquid fire.

themes.label: Food taste and hype
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and the best in the city, but others find it bland, overhyped or worse than before.
quotes: Their food is extremely tasteless which I can rate as bland
The best halal in New York City

themes.label: Cleanliness concerns
themes.text: Some reviewers complain about dirt, litter, smell and food handling, while one notes staff wearing masks and gloves.
quotes: the food is good, the convenience is bad, and the cleanliness is awful.
the area is dirtier than it used to be.

themes.label: Birria tacos quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the birria tacos among the best they have had, praising flavor, tender meat and texture.
quotes: Tacos have an outer crispy layer and a soft layer. Meat is well seasoned and tender.
the meat is really tender and the consome really brings the dish together.

themes.label: Consomé broth
themes.text: The consomé is praised as flavorful and a must-get for dipping tacos, with some saying it rivals the tacos.
quotes: You gotta get the consume and dip the tacos in that lovely broth. Magic right there.
Consome arguably better than taco, but that's splitting hairs.

themes.label: Long lines, worth waiting
themes.text: Many describe long lines and waits of 40 minutes or an hour, but nearly all say the food justified it.
quotes: I literally waited for 40 mins for this, it was totally worth the wait.
The only bad thing about this taco spot is that there's always a wait

themes.label: Low prices, good value
themes.text: Reviewers find the food cheap or fairly priced for the quality and portions.
quotes: Between my husband , child & I we spend 35$ for 9 tacos 1 soup & 2 sodas .
It's also insanely cheap. Staff is also very kind.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most describe friendly, fast staff and a clean truck, though one reviewer found a worker curt about splitting the consomé.
quotes: Place is clean. And the owner and workers are friendly.
The guy aggressively said "no, and to move on with the order".

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Early reviewers praised delicious food, but most later reviewers found it bland, burnt, spoiled, cold or otherwise bad, and some reported hair or bugs.
quotes: Delicious food. Excellent friendly service. Greatest value.
The food is bland and no seasonings at all! Please learn to season your food before opening a restaurant!

themes.label: Rude owner and staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the owner and staff as rude or dismissive, though early reviews called the service friendly and courteous.
quotes: Simply terrible service, owner, Svitlana Flom, take some classes and educate themselves on the proper way to treat people.
the owner/manger whoever she was is extremely rude. With a take it or leave it attitude.

themes.label: Discrimination claims
themes.text: Several reviewers say they were turned away, ignored or threatened with police because of their skin color or ethnicity.

I was told I couldn't eat here because of my skin color.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Later reviewers call the food overpriced for its portion size and quality, while one early reviewer found it good value.
quotes: food was below average and too expensive for the portion size and taste
Overpriced terribly burnt food and rude staff backed up by the owner who is even worse.

themes.label: Cleanliness and atmosphere
themes.text: Early reviewers liked the cosy, pleasant room, but later ones described a dirty restaurant, filthy bathroom or drab atmosphere.
quotes: Pleasant atmosphere. Fast and courteous cervice.

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food

The food is always fresh and delicious and will recommend it to others

themes.label: Reasonable prices

themes.label: Service and staff

She hung up on me, I ordered 2 simple things.

themes.label: Delivery and speed

themes.label: Large portions and freebies

themes.label: Prices and value

themes.label: Atmosphere and outdoor view

It was very loud couldn't talk comfortably gave me a headache, we had to leave

themes.label: Meal taste and recipes

themes.label: Missing or wrong ingredients

themes.label: Late or poor delivery

I am deactivating my account due to poor delivery service through Fed Ex.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Some found support kind and quick to credit or refund, while others could not reach anyone or were refused refunds.

Customer service has been great for this company thus far!

themes.label: Slow service and waits

They take forever at this place. The employees work at their own pace.

themes.label: Staff friendliness

the gentleman that was taking my order was very rude and unprofessional.

themes.label: Cleanliness of dining area

themes.label: Order accuracy and training

themes.label: Food quality and value

themes.label: Food quality and flavor

Shrimp and salmon alfredo is amazing!! They have great portions.

themes.label: Staff and service

themes.label: Prices and value

themes.label: Roast beef sandwiches

The most incredible roast beef sandwich. Razor thin sliced roast beef give it a cotton candy like texture that just bites through with ease

themes.label: Cheese fries and sides

The house fries are really chips they were horrible. Never getting that again.

themes.label: Prices and value

Great food but the prices became waaaay too inflated

it gets very crowded and at times a little insane and wait times tend to be long

Spectacular design, mind-blowing attention to detail, a master-class in branding.

themes.label: Staff and service

Not expensive for what they serve

themes.label: Reservations and seating
themes.text: Several reviewers describe problems with reservations or tables, including a cramped table, an inadequate table and a reservation not honored.
quotes: The Leopard would not honor a reservation that we made a month in advance because someone changed their reservation from 40 people to 80 people.
seated at cramped table adjacent to filthy glassware/waiter cashier station

themes.label: Desserts and pastries
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the desserts, pastries, cheesecake and baklava, though a few found desserts disappointing, stale or even moldy.
quotes: The Napoleons are so fresh and delicious, that I end up getting more than one. Best ones I have ever had.
We used to take people here until we were served moldy cake.

themes.label: Service quality and speed
themes.text: Staff are often called friendly and helpful, but several reviewers describe slow service, and one describes a long wait and a wrong order.
quotes: Slow sevivce but interesting café setting.
Nice place. Friendly staff. Recomended.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, welcoming, romantic setting, with its lighting, windows, back room and street view.
quotes: At night this restaurant is totally romantic ,i love the back room I loooooveeeeee it!!
Beautiful interior lighting at night.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers find the food, coffee and desserts pricey or overpriced, and one wanted bigger portions.
quotes: For pastries and coffee it pretty good. Just a little expensive.
Food was OK....service soso...but completely overpriced

themes.label: Coffee and drinks
themes.text: Coffee and specialty drinks such as the espresso freeze, frappé and mojito get praise, with milkshakes called average.
quotes: The espresso freeze is an absolute taste treat.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, with the duck, steak, burger and small plates singled out, though a few call it mediocre or inconsistent.
quotes: Ordered the duck - the glaze is out of this world and was cooked to PERFECTION.
Food was mediocre. We went there for unlimited drinks for brunch and that was the best part.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, inattentive or absent service, including long waits for drinks or no service at all.
quotes: The staff is attentive & friendly.
No service. Literally none. We waited for close to 20 minutes and left

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Most like the chic, cozy, vintage-feeling room, but some find it too dark or dingy, and one reviewer found the acoustics very noisy.
quotes: But the noise is unbearable- very bad acoustics.

themes.label: Brunch and bottomless drinks
themes.text: Bottomless brunch deals and vouchers are praised, but some found brunch food mediocre, upcharges annoying, or the bottomless time eaten up by delays.
quotes: They serve the whole bottle of champagne with 3 juices to self pour.
man is their breakfast/brunch mediocre. The coffee is terrible

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Several reviewers call it pricey or limited for the cost, while a few say prices are fair or vouchers made it good value.
quotes: Eh, over priced and limited menu
They have excellent dishes for fair prices, there are no long waits even when they are packed.

themes.label: Food taste and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and authentic, but a few found dishes too sweet, too salty, dry or doughy.
quotes: The absolute best Indian I've ever had.
every curry was overloaded with sugar, making them too sweet and taste pretty much the same

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers praise the elaborate, Indian-style interior and the vibe, though one found it intense and another called it a bit much.
quotes: Came for the interior decor, stayed for the chicken korma.
Great new place with great interior decorations, very extravagant & ethnic.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, attentive and quick, with one review noting a waiter's mistakes.
quotes: The service is incredible too, my cup was never empty once.
the waiter had to take our order twice, forgot a drink we ordered

themes.label: Value for price
themes.text: Most find the food reasonably priced or good value, but one reviewer felt lunch specials cost more than comparable nearby restaurants.
quotes: The food is yummy. And very reasonably priced.
For the price you pay on lunch specials you could find other Indian restaurants in neighborhood.

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as fresh, flavorful and authentic, with several saying it is consistently great over many years.
quotes: food fresh all the time
17 years and Counting food always Great

themes.label: Chicken wings
themes.text: Wings are called a must-try and always delicious by some, while another reviewer says they could be better.
quotes: The bbq Wings is a must try
chicken wings could be better.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: One reviewer found waiters helpful at a celebration, while another was ignored and denied service by staff wearing headphones.
quotes: The waiters helped in a very nice manner
upon attempting to order one the people working there blatantly ignored me while wearing headphones

themes.label: Cleanliness and appearance
themes.text: One reviewer calls the place clean with cooking in front of customers, another says the appearance needs renovating, another calls it gorgeous.
quotes: Clean and Cook in front of you.very nice great food
Appearance needs to be renovated though.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many reviewers find the prices high or insane, though some say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: Expensive but quality is high.
the prices are insane and it takes forever for them to make one sandwich even when it isn't busy

themes.label: Pastries and croissants
themes.text: Most praise croissants, brioche and other pastries as excellent, but a few call them average or not fresh.
quotes: Loved loved loved these croissants. Some of the best I've ever had.
The croissants either are yesterday's or they're simply not that well made.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Some find staff friendly, with the bartender praised, while others report slow, indifferent or mistaken service.
quotes: Excellent service and quality products
Terrible service. Mistake was made on their part, yet no urgency to fix the issue

themes.label: Sandwiches
themes.text: Several reviewers love the banh mi, Cubano and other sandwiches, while others found them tasteless or subpar.
quotes: pricey, but the sandwiches were excellent (got a prosciutto + cheese sandwich on a baguette)
Subpar sandwiches, mediocre bread, indifferent staff

themes.label: Wine, cheese and charcuterie
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the wine bar, cheese boards and pâté selection.
quotes: Check out the wine bar and their cheese plateau!
Best cheese board- pate selection was amazing!

themes.label: Wait times and slow service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long lines and slow drink preparation, often blaming understaffing, though a few say the line moves quickly.
quotes: This location is ridiculously slow, especially on weekend mornings. Always a long line but rarely more than two people working to manage the consistent crowd.
I waited for my Mango Dragonfruit drink for 35min, the service was terrible

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive baristas, but others report rude, surly or inattentive staff and order mistakes.
quotes: Friendliest staff, and accommodating - topped up a coffee with hot water and gave extra soy milk.
Surly barista just says they were out of the drink my party ordered and then walked away

themes.label: Seating and upstairs space
themes.text: Reviewers praise the multi-level space and upstairs work areas, while some find too few seats or tables taken by sleepers.
quotes: Love their 2nd floor. Great place to get your work done
the tables are constantly occupied with non-paying sleepers.

themes.label: Bathroom and cleanliness
themes.text: Some find the store clean and well kept, but others report dirty floors and bathrooms lacking soap or toilet paper.
quotes: Well taken care of. Clean all around
This was one of the most disgusting bathrooms I've ever walked into.

themes.label: Loud music
themes.text: Two reviewers found the music too loud, one comparing it to a dance club in the morning.
quotes: Two levels with a ton of seating. Music is way too loud!

themes.label: Service quality and staff
themes.text: Some reviewers praise friendly, efficient service and hard-working staff, while others describe rude, poorly trained or unfriendly employees and weak management.
quotes: I'm not fan of fast food but service there is really great !!!
They have the worst managerial staff. The employees talk extremely too much and they get the orders wrong.

themes.label: Wait times and speed
themes.text: Many describe long waits, single open registers and slow drive-thru, though several others say ordering and food were quick.
quotes: It took 10min to get to the window. Then to wait another 10min for the food.
Order process was fast and the wait time for my food was fast as well

themes.label: Wrong or missing orders
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly report orders that are wrong, incomplete or items out of stock, and advise checking the bag.
quotes: They always forget to put things in the bag. I would understand if it was a one off thing but it happens every time.
Make sure to always check your order or you will be disappointed.

themes.label: Cleanliness and bathrooms
themes.text: Most comments cite dirty bathrooms, sticky tables and a dirty feel, though one reviewer says it has become clean and another calls it clean.
quotes: Nice fancy looking place but dirty. Sticky tables with dry ketchup.
Clean. Used to be dirty. McDonalds is stepping it up.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Opinions on the food split between fresh, hot, tasty items such as fries and frappes and complaints of overcooked, processed or disgusting food.
quotes: Food was so fresh and crispy. Huge parking and drive thru also good enough.
Fish sandwich is highly processed and costs 6.50. Not good.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and rudeness
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, smiling staff and good service, while others describe rude or ignoring front-desk staff and condescending treatment.
quotes: The woman in the front is the best. My good friend, always greeted me with a smile and eventually remembered me and my order.
HORRIBLE customer service! Walked in there tonight-the host at front, totally ignored my question, I thought she didn't hear me I asked again

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers call prices cheap, reasonable or good value, but some find them high or overpriced for the portions received.
quotes: Prices are LOWER than Chinese in Ohio, where I come from. The food is just as good or better.
The portions are smaller than most Chinese restaurants for the price.

themes.label: Food quality and taste
themes.text: Many describe the food as fresh, tasty and excellent, while others report bland, greasy, soggy, sour or spoiled dishes.
quotes: The foid was fresh and tasty. I would recommend Ocrsn Dragon to anyone who likes Chinese food.
the shrimp was sour, smelled super funky, it was completely spoiled.

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: Reviewers describe a small, cozy restaurant with limited seating, though one found the room and tables dirty.
quotes: Only thing is that it is small (what can you expect in NYC). So seating is limited and take out can be a wait.
Room in poor condition, dirty and decadent.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Several reviewers say food arrives quickly and takeout is fast, though a couple report long delivery or order delays.
quotes: Prices are not bad and the food is prepared quickly. Not a large space. Cozy.
It took them 1 hour and 15 min to delivery my lunch.

themes.label: Authentic Thai flavors
themes.text: Reviewers praise bold, spicy, authentic Thai flavors that go beyond typical American Thai menus, though one found the soup too sweet and another found dishes just okay.
quotes: Delicious food from a menu that's not so heavy on the American Thai restaurant usuals.
Lots of strong and authentic flavors in a menu that combines salads prepared in a mortar with options from the grill

themes.label: Chicken wings
themes.text: The chicken wings, including fish sauce or duck sauce versions, are repeatedly singled out as among the best reviewers have had.
quotes: The chicken wings were probably the best I've ever had.
it has now become my top Thai takeout spot! Get the duck sauce wings

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive service, but a February 2020 review says staff seemed to want guests gone and had lost motivation.
quotes: Service was attentive, friendly and helpful.
Staff wants you to leave as soon as you walk in the door.

themes.label: Papaya salad
themes.text: Papaya salad (som tum) is praised as excellent, with some kick, including one reviewer calling it among the best in NYC.
quotes: One of the best papaya salad that I've ever had in nyc!

themes.label: Cash only policy
themes.text: One reviewer found cash-only payment a bummer, while another noted a 10% discount for paying in cash.
quotes: Food = good Cash only = bummer
if you pay in cash, you get 10% of your bill.

themes.label: Bottomless brunch deal
themes.text: Reviewers praise the unlimited food and drinks brunch as good value, with attentive staff keeping everything coming.
quotes: server was so helpful and at our table every minute bringing out literal bottomless food and drinks
$50 for unlimited food and drinks, you can't beat that especially when they food is good and the drinks are strong

themes.label: Happy hour
themes.text: Many like the long happy hour, its specials and atmosphere, but some find it crowded and loud, or the drinks weak.
quotes: loved the food, the happy hour atmosphere and great prices for a long happy hour
Only downside is it gets crowded fast, so it's hard to find a seat.

themes.label: Service quality and speed
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, though some report slow or rushed service, rudeness, or delays when crowded.
quotes: The staff is friendly, informative & helpful.
Service bottlenecks tremendously, Lincoln Tunnel-style, after 12:30 PM.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most call the food delicious, especially the guacamole, but a few found it average or low quality.
quotes: The guacamole with the tuna tartare was amazing.
Guacamole with no taste Tacos with cold meat inside, seems to be come from microwave.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some see the pricey menu as worth it, while others call it overpriced or note small portions.
quotes: Upscale, pricy but well worth the price
Amazing Margaritas and ambiance but the food portions are super small.
